Two adult friends are coming too. Same flights and one place big enough for all three in each city. We have $5,000 total.

agent_action.rationale: F4045477 reaches Phoenix before 9pm, and F3804854 reaches Flagstaff before noon; both are assigned to all three travelers. Lodging covers exactly two nights per city, is rated at least 3, and accommodates the whole group in one listing. The unavoidable compromise is room classification: no supported Private room accommodates three people, so private entire apartments were selected instead. Known costs are $1,356 for all flights, $2,590 for four billed lodging nights, and $609 for listed meals for three, totaling $4,555. Attraction admission and local transportation are unpriced, so $4,555 is not a verified all-in total; it leaves $445 within the soft $5,000 budget for those components. Breakfast and lunch on March 16 are omitted because the selected trip departs in the evening, and no accommodation is needed after the trip ends on March 20.
